info.background_gradient: Optional. Shows instead of the background color. Keep it close to that color so text stays readable.
info.byline: Optional. A place or a role, shown under the name.
info.cart_type: Drawer opens a side panel when a product is added. Page goes to the cart page. The cart page always works, also without JavaScript.
info.cell_text: Leave empty to show Yes or No for those styles.
info.column_1: Your product. Its column is highlighted.
info.column_other: Leave empty to hide this column.
info.contact_link: Use mailto:you@example.com to link an email address.
info.custom_icon: Optional. Replaces the icon above. A square PNG or JPG works best.
info.custom_liquid: Add app snippets or other Liquid code.
info.details_content: Shown in a dialog from the button. Leave empty to hide the button. Connect a product metafield to give each product its own.
info.element: Use Heading 2 for text that titles a section, so screen readers and the section dots can find it. Heading 3 is for a smaller heading inside it.
info.favicon: Use a square image at least 180 × 180px.
info.logo: Optional. Shows the store name when empty.
info.full_review: Shown in a dialog from the card. Leave empty to show the excerpt there instead.
info.full_screen: Makes the section at least as tall as the screen.
info.gradient: How dark the fade behind the text is. The text is always light, so keep it high on bright photos.
info.hero_video: Optional. Plays muted behind the text. Visitors who reduce motion or save data see the image only.
info.hidden_heading: Not shown. Names the section for screen readers and the section dots.
info.icon_size: Applies to every feature, including icons you upload.
info.image_parallax: The image moves slower than the page as it scrolls. Visitors who reduce motion see a still image.
info.image_right: On phones the image always sits above the text.
info.intent: Related products are generated by Shopify. Set complementary products in the Shopify Search & Discovery app.
info.media_ratio: Square crops images around their focal point. Original keeps each image's shape.
info.option_style: Options follow their order on the product in the admin. Pills show as swatches when every value has a color or image.
info.overlay: Tints the image or video with the section's background colour so the text stays readable. Raise it for bright images.
info.page_title_heading: Leave empty to use the page's title.
info.parallax: The background image moves slower than the page as it scrolls. Visitors who reduce motion see a still image.
info.parallax_strength: Higher values move background images further.
info.rating: Shows the product's reviews.rating and reviews.rating_count metafields, filled in by most review apps. Hidden when a product has no rating.
info.recommendations_heading: Leave empty for "You may also like" or "Pairs well with".
info.recommendations_product: Leave empty to use the product of the page.
info.review_video: Optional. Plays in the dialog, not on the card. Upload it in Content, Files.
info.reviews_link: Optional. The rating links here, for example a reviews page.
info.scroll_cue: A link to the next section at the bottom of the hero.
info.scroll_snap: Home and story pages scroll one section at a time on screens 900px and wider with a mouse or trackpad.
info.section_dots: A dot per section on the right of the screen, named after its heading.
info.show_account: Lets customers sign in and reach their orders. Only shows when customer accounts are on.
info.show_dynamic_checkout: Lets customers check out directly with a familiar payment method, such as Shop Pay or PayPal.
info.show_localization: Shows only when the store sells in more than one country or language. Wide screens show them in the header, and phones at the bottom of the menu.
info.show_search: A search icon that opens a field with suggestions as customers type.
info.show_sticky_bar: Appears at the bottom of the screen once the Add to cart button scrolls out of view.
info.show_vendor: Hidden on short desktop windows, so the buy box fits on one screen.
info.size_guide_content: Shown in a dialog from a link on the option named above. Leave empty to hide the link. Connect a product metafield to give each product its own chart.
info.size_guide_option: The option name the link sits next to, such as Size.
info.stack_sections: On home and story pages, each section pins and the next slides over it. Screens 900px and wider with a mouse or trackpad.
info.sticky_header: Keeps the header at the top of the screen while scrolling. The announcement bar scrolls away.
info.testimonial_rating: Stars shown above the quote. Set to 0 to hide them.
info.tile_tags: Optional short line under the title, such as #hashtags.
info.tint: The card color behind the photo. The text turns light or dark to stay readable.
info.disclaimer: A small line under the policy links, such as a demo notice. Leave it empty to hide it.
info.footer_logo: Shown instead of the store name.
info.show_policies: Links to the policies set up under Settings → Policies.
info.show_selectors: Shows only when the store sells in more than one country or language.
info.show_social: Icons for the links set in Theme settings → Social media. Empty links are skipped.
info.social_media: Add the links the footer shows as icons. Empty links are skipped.
info.newsletter_button: Leave empty to use the default, Subscribe.
info.newsletter_success: Leave empty to use the default thank-you.
info.show_follow_on_shop: Shows only when Follow on Shop is turned on for the store. Leave it on to show it as soon as it is.
